verdict.rationale: Browser Use Cloud documents a clear CAPTCHA stance. Automatic CAPTCHA solving is on by default for V4 Agent runs and standalone Cloud Browser sessions, and if a challenge remains the docs direct you to the live preview for human control. Coverage is still incomplete: the docs say only 'supported' challenges are solved, with no list of unsupported types, and nothing shows how an unsolved CAPTCHA is surfaced instead of failing silently. missing for 10: enumerated supported/unsupported CAPTCHA types, documented failure signaling or events when solving fails, a stated stance for the open-source local library, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can rely on a documented captcha stance — automatic solving, human fallback, or explicit non-support — instead of silent task failures

citations.quote: Automatic CAPTCHA solving is enabled by default for API V4 Agent runs and standalone Cloud Browser sessions.
Cloud browsers solve supported CAPTCHA challenges automatically.
If the challenge remains, open the [live preview](/cloud/browser/live-preview) for human control.
Every Browser Use Cloud browser enables automatic CAPTCHA solving.
